items.title: Malicious VS Code Extension as Icon Theme Attacking Windows and macOS Users
items.description: A malicious Visual Studio Code extension posing as the popular “Material Icon Theme” has been used to attack Windows and macOS users, turning the add-on into a hidden backdoor.
